text:
maya (support): Acme reports sporadic 502/504s hitting /v1/generate since ~08:00 UTC. They see a cluster of failures when sending ~20k token prompts. They say SDK retries are piling up.

acme-integration-bot: Posting customer's repro curl: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"rwdl-large-1","input":"<~20k token payload>"}' --max-time 120```

kai (cust success): Customer provided correlation-id: cid=acme-2026-03-16-08-12-33-1a2b3c. Also attached sample logs from their SDK showing repeated 502 then exponential backoff.

maya (support): Thanks—logging this and escalating to SRE. Customer is asking for ETA and a short-term mitigation.

devon (sre): Looking. Any quick pattern? p95 for this tenant or region?

maya (support): They said region=us-east-1, p95 latency spikes to 18s before the error, otherwise normal ~200-400ms. Failures started after a spike in average prompt length.

devon (sre): Reproducing locally now with a trimmed payload. Quick hypothesis: large KV cache + long seq triggers longer exec time; upstream proxy may hit idle/timeout or connection pool drains when requests block. Need runtime + edge traces. @olivia can you pull model runtime traces for rwdl-large-1 for that period?

olivia (eng-runtime): Pulling traces, will also check GPU worker logs and KV cache thrash. If the worker holds the connection open >15s we might hit our edge keepalive/idle thresholds.

acme-integration-bot: Customer also noted their SDK retries double after ~3 failures causing a retry storm. They temporarily limited concurrency to 3 which reduced errors.

devon (sre): That suggests queueing/backpressure at the proxy layer. Two immediate mitigations: 1) Ask customer to limit client concurrency and increase client-side read timeout to 90s. 2) We can temporarily raise edge upstream timeout on their route and add a per-tenant circuit-breaker to shed.

maya (support): Can we provide a quick config change for their tenant while we investigate? Customer wants something they can test in next 30 min.

olivia (eng-runtime): I can flip a temporary routing rule to raise the gateway idle timeout from 30s -> 90s for tenant acme-123 for 1 hour. Also add a per-route queue-depth cap to avoid pooled conn exhaustion. Will require a short deploy.

deploy-bot: Started canary deploy id dpl-7823 for routing-config-change -> target acme-123.

devon (sre): Meanwhile I pulled the edge logs: multiple connections from acme IPs show upstream responses delayed ~12-20s and then NGINX returning 502 or 504 due to backend resets. There's also spikes in keepalive connection re-use failures: `http: upstream prematurely closed connection` in the proxy logs.

olivia (eng-runtime): GPU worker logs show occasional GC-like pause in the model process around the same times — not full OOM, but long stall when serving very long sequences with KV compaction. We're seeing lock contention on the kvcache mutex causing blocking serialization of tokens for concurrent requests.

devon (sre): OK root cause seems to be: long-running requests holding worker threads -> connection holding at edge -> connection pool limits + edge timeouts -> proxy returns 5xx -> client retries amplify. Action plan: short-term edge timeout increase + per-tenant queue cap; mid-term: add async KV compaction, increase worker concurrency and tune mutexing; long-term: provide model variant guidance or chunking best-practices.

maya (support): I'll message the customer with short-term steps and ETA for config change. Draft: "We're seeing the long prompts cause worker stalls that are topping our proxy connection limits. We're applying a temporary timeout increase and queue cap for your tenant to reduce 5xx while we implement a runtime fix. Can you also reduce concurrent in-flight requests to 3 and set SDK read timeout to 90s?" Any edits?

kai (cust success): Add: we'll monitor for 20 minutes post-change and then decide whether to rollback. Also offer a temporary token to route them to a higher-capacity pool if they need higher concurrency.

olivia (eng-runtime): Config change rolled in canary and metrics look good. No error spike during canary. Deploying to 30% traffic now.

deploy-bot: Deploy dpl-7823 -> 30% complete.

maya (support): Sent to customer with comms above and included the correlation id.

acme-integration-bot: Customer confirms reduced errors after decreasing concurrency, waiting for our config update to validate.

devon (sre): Canary to 100% complete. Edge timeout for acme-123 now 90s, per-route queue cap enabled. Observability: reduced 502 rate by ~85% for their tenant.

olivia (eng-runtime): Filing GH issue rwd-infer#1427 for KV cache mutexing; assigning to runtime team. Estimated fix: 2-3 sprints for nonblocking compaction path. Quick patch: increase worker thread pool for high-seq models as interim.

maya (support): Customer updated: "Thanks, errors dropped a lot. We're OK with interim settings. Please keep us posted on the runtime fix timeline"

devon (sre): Follow-ups: 1) Add automated alert for per-tenant 5xx > 1% p10 increase, 2) add guidance to SDK docs about concurrency & read-timeout for large prompts, 3) track regression after KV fix.

maya (support): Closing loop in 24h unless customer reopens. Marking as monitored. :white_check_mark:
